purpose: An explorable-looking, read-only 3D visualization of fictional electric-vehicle simulation, authorization verdicts and reproducible evidence. Vehicle movement is a projected representation of GHOSTWHEEL snapshots, NOT real-world actuation or an independent physics/collision model.
runtimeSurface: GHOSTWHEEL React/Vite browser Operations; optional Windows Tauri viewer after separately gated runtime approval

hero.role: Single projected ASTER/VECTOR/NOMAD teaching vehicle. Grounded to a protected central simulation plane; full initial silhouette visible from production camera.

exceptions: Event chronology advances left-to-right in UI overlay for reading order; this overlay is not architectural geometry.

circulation.description: Human spectators enter from the south via 3.6 m clear aperture; keep 2.4 m unobstructed routes around the central projection. The virtual car is a non-colliding holographic data display, not a driveable room collision actor. Never pretend the existing simulator implements boundaries or stopping distances.
